findings.title: Check-in date already passed
findings.cause: The offer stays in data/trips.db after its date and build() exports every stored offer; validate only stops past dates at insert time.
findings.action: Skip offers with check_in < today when building (diff in proposals/quality.md).

findings.title: Stored offer fails today's validate rules
findings.cause: Saved before the rule existed or was tightened; the DB is never re-validated, so it is published on every run until it is deleted.
findings.owner: trips/run.py build() (re-run validate.problems on stored offers)
findings.action: Skip (and log) stored offers that fail validate.problems in build().

findings.title: Adults-only / naturist property shown as a fit
findings.cause: The name says adults only (or naturist) but no rule excludes it; family facts are unknown so the score only caps it.
findings.action: Set family.adults_only = True when the name matches and fail the hard rule.

findings.title: Stay length differs from the page's configured nights
findings.cause: Savana's cheapest 'from' price is often a 6-night stay; Supernova's early-season columns have a 3-night minimum stay. Prices for different stay lengths are compared per night by the scorer but listed side by side on the dashboard.
findings.action: Prefer the configured stay length when the card lists it; otherwise keep, but label.

findings.title: Area beyond the drive limit (345 min incl. tolerance)
findings.cause: These pages are scraped every run but every offer is excluded (drive too long, no direct flight): wasted polite requests and clutter in data.json.
findings.action: Disable those pages (or mark them direct_flight_skp when a charter exists).

findings.title: Check-in = the day it was scraped
findings.cause: The parser had no usable date and fell back to today (max(date_from, today)). Nobody books a ski week for the same afternoon; the price is for the agency's own window.
findings.action: Use the page's configured check_in when the card's window already started.

findings.title: Placeholder image used as the hotel photo
findings.cause: The agency's 'no photo' default thumbnail was taken as the photo.
findings.owner: trips/sources/mk_agencies.py (card image) → now nulled by validate.bad_image

findings.title: Thumbnail-size photo (< 400 px)
findings.cause: The card thumbnail was taken instead of the large photo (profile=sm, _thumb_ sizes).

findings.title: '(ex. Old name)' left in the hotel name
findings.cause: Agencies append the former name; it breaks cross-source matching and looks messy.
findings.action: Strip r'\s*\(\s*ex\.?[^)]*\)' like charters._clean_name does; keep it in notes.

findings.title: Per-night price far below similar offers (< median / 2.5)
findings.cause: Usually a per-person or per-day price read as a whole unit/stay (check the unit text), or a 2-3 night minimum stay priced as a week.

findings.title: Per-night price far above similar offers (> 3 × median)
findings.cause: Large luxury villas (sleeps 8-12) priced for the whole house: real, but never a family deal; or a per-stay price multiplied by nights.
findings.action: Cap villas by bedrooms/sleeps (e.g. ≤ 4 bedrooms) in the parser.
